criteria.text: The current GHCR access of the production claude-deploy identity is measured against an existing immutable private image with docker manifest inspect; no image pull, credential value, or Docker config content is emitted.

If the measurement is denied, the claude-deploy GHCR credential is replaced through a secure channel with the least privilege needed to read the private package, with the prior config restored on any failed verification and no secret stored in the repository or logs.

The final state is proved by a successful read-only manifest inspection as claude-deploy; the issue remains open if replacement cannot be completed safely, and no deploy, image pull, service mutation, migration, reindex, push, or paid call is performed.
